title: Ordinary Portland Cement — Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for ordinary Portland cement, 33 grade, 43 grade, and 53 grade, for general construction purposes.
description: Specifies composition, physical and chemical requirements, sampling, and tests for OPC cement used in concrete and mortar.

title: Portland Slag Cement — Specification
scope: This standard covers the manufacture and chemical and physical requirements of Portland slag cement.
description: Provides the detailed specification for PSC, widely used in marine structures and mass concrete.

title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete - Code of Practice
scope: Deals with the general structural use of plain and reinforced concrete. Covers materials, structural design principles, and workmanship.
description: The fundamental code for concrete design in India, addressing the structural design, materials, and safety factors.

title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete - Specification
scope: Covers the requirements for naturally occurring aggregates, manufactured aggregates, and recycled aggregates for concrete.
description: Specifies grading zones, physical properties, and testing methods for aggregates to be used in standard concrete.

title: Concrete Mix Proportioning - Guidelines
scope: Provides guidelines for proportioning concrete mixes as per the requirements of IS 456.
description: Guidelines for determining the proportions of cement, water, fine and coarse aggregates for various grades of concrete.

title: Portland Pozzolana Cement - Specification Part 1 Fly Ash Based
scope: Covers manufacture, physical and chemical requirements of Portland pozzolana cement (fly ash based).
description: Widely used for general civil engineering construction works, especially mass concrete and marine structures.

title: 43 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification
scope: Requirements for 43 grade OPC. Note: Superseded by IS 269:2015.
description: Previously specified the requirements for 43 grade cement. Now covered under the unified IS 269 standard.

title: 53 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification
scope: Requirements for 53 grade OPC. Note: Superseded by IS 269:2015.
description: Previously specified the requirements for 53 grade cement. Now covered under the unified IS 269 standard.

title: Pulverized Fuel Ash - Specification Part 1 For Use as Pozzolana in Cement, Cement Mortar and Concrete
scope: Specifies physical and chemical requirements for fly ash to be used in concrete.
description: Essential standard for utilizing fly ash in sustainable concrete construction to improve durability.

title: Methods of physical tests for hydraulic cement Part 1 Determination of fineness by dry sieving
scope: Describes the method for determining the fineness of cement.
description: Crucial laboratory test method for cement quality control.

title: Method of Tests for Strength of Concrete
scope: Lays down the methods for determining the compressive, flexural, and split tensile strength of concrete.
description: The primary testing standard for concrete cubes and cylinders to verify compressive strength.

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel - Specification
scope: Covers the requirements of steel plates, sections and bars for use in structural work.
description: The standard grade structural steel specification for general engineering purposes, including bridges and building frames.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for high strength deformed steel bars and wires used as concrete reinforcement.
description: Standard for TMT bars, detailing chemical composition, mechanical properties like yield stress and elongation.

title: Steel Tubes, Tubulars and Other Wrought Steel Fittings - Part 1 : Steel Tubes
scope: Covers the requirements for welded and seamless plain end or screwed and socketed steel tubes.
description: Commonly used for water, gas, and steam distribution systems.

title: Hollow Steel Sections for Structural Use - Specification
scope: Covers the requirements for hot formed and cold formed square and rectangular hollow steel sections.
description: Used extensively in structural frames, columns, and architectural applications.

title: Steel Pipes for Water and Sewage (168.3 to 2540 mm Outside Diameter) - Specification
scope: Requirements for steel pipes of large diameter used for transporting water and sewage.
description: Standard for large diameter welded steel pipes for major water transmission networks.

title: Steel Tubes for Structural Purposes - Specification
scope: Covers the requirements for hot finished and cold formed welded and seamless carbon steel tubes for structural purposes.
description: Used for scaffolds, general structures, and mechanical purposes.

title: Galvanized Steel Sheets (Plain and Corrugated) - Specification
scope: Covers the requirements for hot-dip galvanized steel sheets, plain and corrugated.
description: Widely used for roofing, cladding, and general fabrication to provide corrosion resistance.

title: Cold Reduced Low Carbon Steel Sheets and Strips - Specification
scope: Covers the requirements for cold reduced low carbon steel sheets and strips for drawing and forming.
description: Used in automotive body panels, white goods, and other deep drawing applications.

title: Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated Unsheathed and Sheathed Cables/Cords with Rigid and Flexible Conductor
scope: Specifies PVC insulated cables for working voltages up to and including 1100 V.
description: Standard for typical domestic and industrial wiring cables for power and lighting circuits.

title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets of Rated Voltage up to and including 250 V and Rated Current up to and including 16 A
scope: Covers general requirements and tests for plugs and socket-outlets for household and similar purposes.
description: Safety standard for common electrical outlets and plugs used in India.

title: Code of Practice for Earthing
scope: Provides guidelines for the design, installation, and maintenance of earthing systems.
description: Essential code for ensuring electrical safety by proper grounding of equipment and structures.

title: Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations
scope: Guidelines for the design, installation, and inspection of electrical wiring systems in buildings.
description: Covers wiring methods, conductor sizes, and safety requirements for low voltage installations.

title: Busbar Trunking Systems - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for busbar trunking systems for electrical power distribution.
description: Used in industrial plants and high-rise buildings for efficient power transmission.

title: Power Transformers - Part 1: General
scope: Provides general requirements, ratings, and testing procedures for power transformers.
description: The fundamental standard for large transformers used in transmission networks.

title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables - Specification
scope: Requirements for PVC insulated heavy-duty cables for working voltages up to 1100 V.
description: Commonly used for underground power distribution and industrial power circuits.

title: Crosslinked Polyethylene Insulated Thermoplastic Sheathed Cables - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for XLPE insulated cables for working voltages up to 1.1 kV.
description: Provides higher temperature ratings and better electrical properties compared to PVC cables.

title: Information Technology Equipment - Safety - Part 1: General Requirements
scope: Applies to mains-powered or battery-powered information technology equipment, including electrical business equipment.
description: Safety standard for IT products, preventing hazards from electrical shock, fire, and mechanical injury.

title: Secondary Cells and Batteries containing Alkaline or other non-acid Electrolytes
scope: Safety requirements for portable sealed secondary cells, and for batteries made from them, for use in portable applications.
description: Ensures the safety of rechargeable batteries, particularly lithium-ion and nickel systems, under normal and fault conditions.

title: Luminaires - Part 5: Particular Requirements - Sec 1: General Purpose Luminaires
scope: Specifies requirements for general purpose luminaires for use with tungsten filament, tubular fluorescent and other discharge lamps.
description: Ensures electrical, thermal and mechanical safety of lighting fixtures.

title: Unplasticized PVC Pipes for Potable Water Supplies - Specification
scope: Requirements for uPVC pipes intended for buried and above-ground water supply networks.
description: Standard for rigid PVC pipes used widely in agricultural and domestic water supply systems.

title: Injection Moulded PVC Fittings with Solvent Cement Joints for Water Supplies
scope: Covers requirements for injection moulded uPVC fittings for solvent cement jointing with uPVC pipes.
description: Fittings compatible with IS 4985 pipes, including elbows, tees, and couplers.

title: Unplasticized PVC Screen and Casing Pipes for Bore/Tube Wells
scope: Requirements for ribbed screen, plain screen, and casing pipes made of uPVC.
description: Specially designed for groundwater extraction, providing resistance to corrosion and scaling.

title: Centrifugally Cast (Spun) Iron Pressure Pipes for Water, Gas and Sewage
scope: Requirements for spun iron pipes used for conveying water, gas, and sewage under pressure.
description: Traditional pipes for municipal water distribution, now largely replaced by DI pipes.

title: Code of Practice for Laying of Cast Iron Pipes
scope: Guidelines for laying, jointing, and testing of cast iron pipes for water supply.
description: Ensures proper installation techniques for durability and leak prevention.

title: Ductile Iron Pipes for Water, Gas and Sewage - Specification
scope: Covers centrifugally cast ductile iron pipes for pressure water supply, gas, and sewerage.
description: Modern standard for high-strength, flexible metal pipes for municipal infrastructure.

title: Selection, Installation and Maintenance of First-Aid Fire Extinguishers - Code of Practice
scope: Provides recommendations for the selection, installation, and maintenance of fire extinguishers.
description: Vital safety code for commercial and residential buildings to ensure fire readiness.

title: Industrial Safety Helmets - Specification
scope: Requirements for safety helmets intended to provide protection against falling objects.
description: Specifies impact absorption, penetration resistance, and flame resistance for protective headgear.

title: Portable Fire Extinguishers - Performance and Construction
scope: Specifies requirements for portable fire extinguishers, replacing several older individual standards.
description: Comprehensive standard covering multiple extinguishing agents like water, foam, powder, and CO2.

title: Code of Practice for Fire Safety of Buildings - General Principles
scope: General principles of fire grading and classification of buildings based on occupancy.
description: Forms the basis for building bylaws and fire safety regulations in India.

title: Code of Practice for Fire Safety of Buildings - Details of Construction
scope: Provides details on construction materials and methods to ensure fire resistance.
description: Complements IS 1641 by detailing structural requirements for different fire resistance ratings.

title: Portable Fire Extinguishers, Dry Powder (Cartridge Type)
scope: Specification for cartridge-type dry powder fire extinguishers. Note: largely superseded by IS 15683.
description: Older standard specifically for dry powder extinguishers, detailing construction and testing.

title: Drinking Water - Specification
scope: Prescribes the requirements and methods of sampling and test for drinking water.
description: Sets the acceptable limits for physical, chemical, and biological parameters of potable water in India.

title: Water Treatment Plants - Code of Practice
scope: Covers general layout, design criteria, and functional requirements of municipal water treatment plants.
description: Guide for engineers designing coagulation, flocculation, and filtration systems.

title: Methods of Sampling and Test (Physical and Chemical) for Water and Wastewater
scope: Prescribes general rules for sampling and physical/chemical testing.
description: The foundation standard (multi-part) for laboratory analysis of water quality.

title: Tolerance Limits for Inland Surface Waters Subject to Pollution
scope: Prescribes tolerance limits for various classes of inland surface waters.
description: Classifies rivers and lakes based on designated best use (e.g., drinking, bathing, industrial).

title: Guidelines for Quality of Irrigation Water
scope: Sets parameters for water quality suitable for agricultural irrigation.
description: Considers factors like salinity, sodicity, and specific ion toxicity for crops.

title: Methods of Test for Safety Evaluation of Cosmetics
scope: Safety test methods. (Note: Often confused with soybean standards, but this is the actual title for IS 4011).
description: Specifies dermatological and toxicological tests for cosmetic products.

title: Methods of Test for Animal Feeds and Feeding Stuffs
scope: Test methods for determining nutritional value of animal feed.
description: Provides procedures for analyzing moisture, crude protein, and fat content.

title: Malted Milk Foods - Specification
scope: Requirements for malted milk foods.
description: Specifies composition, hygiene, and packaging requirements for malted milk products.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) - Specification
scope: Requirements for drinking water packed in retail containers.
description: Stringent standard for treatment processes, hygiene, and limits for chemical and microbiological contaminants.

title: Bhatura - Specification
scope: Specification for fried Indian bread (Bhatura).
description: Details ingredients, preparation methods, and quality characteristics for commercial Bhatura.

title: Outdoor Type Oil Immersed Distribution Transformers Upto and Including 2500 kVA, 33kV - Specification
scope: Requirements for distribution transformers, including energy efficiency levels.
description: Mandates multiple star ratings (Levels 1, 2, 3) to reduce distribution losses in the power grid.

title: Dry-Type Power Transformers - Specification
scope: Applies to dry-type power transformers (including auto-transformers).
description: Used indoors and in environments where oil-filled transformers pose a fire hazard.

title: Switches for Domestic and Similar Purposes
scope: Requirements for manually operated general purpose switches.
description: Safety standard for typical light switches used in homes and offices.

title: Low-Voltage Switchgear and Controlgear - Part 1: General Rules
scope: General requirements for switchgear and controlgear intended to be connected to circuits up to 1000 V AC.
description: Foundation standard for circuit breakers, contactors, and disconnectors.

title: Electrical Accessories - Circuit-Breakers for Overcurrent Protection for Household and Similar Installations
scope: Requirements for MCBs.
description: Modern standard replacing older switchgear rules for domestic circuit breakers.

title: Conductors for Insulated Electrical Cables and Flexible Cords
scope: Specifies requirements for solid, stranded, and flexible conductors of copper and aluminium.
description: Defines conductor classes (Class 1, 2, 5, 6) based on flexibility and resistance.

title: Aerial Bunched Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V
scope: Requirements for aerial bunched cables (ABC) with XLPE insulation.
description: Used extensively for overhead power distribution to reduce power theft and improve reliability.

title: Elastomer Insulated Cables - Part 1: For Working Voltages upto and including 1100 V
scope: Cables with rubber-like insulation.
description: Used in harsh environments where flexibility and heat resistance are required.

title: Aluminum Conductors for Overhead Transmission Purposes
scope: Requirements for hard-drawn aluminium wire.
description: Standard for AAC overhead transmission line conductors.

title: Aluminum Conductors Galvanized Steel Reinforced
scope: Requirements for ACSR conductors.
description: Standard for the most common overhead transmission line conductors.

title: AC Static Watt-hour Meters, Class 1 and 2
scope: Requirements for static (electronic) watt-hour meters for active energy.
description: The primary standard for residential digital electricity meters.

title: AC Static Transformer Operated Watt-hour and VAR-hour Meters
scope: Requirements for high precision commercial and industrial energy meters.
description: Standard for class 0.2S and 0.5S meters used in substations and large industries.

title: A.C. Static Direct Connected Watt-Hour Smart Meter Class 1 and 2
scope: Requirements for smart meters with bidirectional communication capabilities.
description: Foundational standard for the nationwide rollout of smart metering infrastructure in India.

title: AC Electricity Meters - Part 1: General Requirements
scope: Older standard for electromechanical energy meters.
description: Largely phased out in favor of static meters, but historically significant.

title: Hexagon Head Bolts, Screws and Nuts of Product Grade C - Part 1: Hexagon Head Bolts
scope: Specifies characteristics of hexagon head bolts with threads M5 to M64.
description: Standard for general-purpose structural and mechanical bolts.

title: Technical Supply Conditions for Threaded Steel Fasteners
scope: General requirements for bolts, screws, studs, and nuts.
description: Covers mechanical properties, testing, and inspection of fasteners.

title: Heavy Hexagon Structural Bolts
scope: Requirements for high-strength structural bolts.
description: Used in steel construction and bridges requiring high tensile strength connections.

title: Hexagon Head Bolts, Screws and Nuts of Product Grades A and B
scope: High precision hexagon bolts.
description: Used in automotive and machinery where tighter tolerances are required.

title: Foundation Bolts - Specification
scope: Covers requirements for foundation bolts used for industrial machinery and steel structures.
description: Details dimensions and types (J-type, L-type) for anchoring structures to concrete.

title: Painting of Concrete, Masonry and Plaster Surfaces - Code of Practice
scope: Guidelines for surface preparation and application of paints.
description: Ensures proper adhesion and durability of architectural paints on building surfaces.

title: Plastic Emulsion Paint - Specification
scope: Requirements for interior plastic emulsion paints.
description: Specifies drying time, finish, washability, and resistance properties for premium wall paints.

title: Methods of Sampling and Test for Paints, Varnishes and Related Products
scope: General testing procedures for paints.
description: Foundational multi-part standard detailing laboratory tests for viscosity, opacity, and drying time.

title: Enamel, Synthetic, Exterior: (a) Undercoating (b) Finishing - Specification
scope: Requirements for synthetic enamel paints used for exterior and interior protection.
description: Used widely on metal and wood surfaces for a glossy, durable finish.

title: Textiles - Woven Shirting Fabrics - Specification
scope: Requirements for woven fabrics intended for shirting.
description: Specifies dimensions, color fastness, and dimensional stability for shirt materials.

title: Textiles - Uniform Fabrics - Specification
scope: Requirements for fabrics used in institutional and industrial uniforms.
description: Ensures durability, tear strength, and color fastness for heavy-use garments.

title: Textiles - Polyester Cotton Blended Fabrics
scope: Requirements for fabrics blended from polyester and cotton fibers.
description: Balances the breathability of cotton with the wrinkle-resistance of polyester.
